svg.title: The Atbash Cipher
svg.desc: Thirteen nested arches pair A with Z, B with Y, down to M with N. Each letter of HELLO travels along its arch, giving SVOOL; applying Atbash again returns HELLO.

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', 'Book Antiqua', 'DejaVu Serif', serif

svg.text: Fold the alphabet in half: every letter swaps places with its mirror image.
